claims.text: HRW 2009: more than 4,000 rockets fired 2001–2008; 'None of these rockets can be reliably aimed'; inherently indiscriminate toward populated areas; war crimes; fired from populated areas; Abu Obeida: 'We will double the number of Israelis under fire'; Mashaal: 'Firing these rockets is a method and not the goal'; Hamas did not prosecute.

HRW Aug 2021: May 2021 rockets killed 12 Israeli civilians; misfire killed seven Palestinians in Jabaliya; indiscriminate firing a war crime; Hamas: aims to develop capability to 'accurately target Israeli military headquarters'.
HRW 2012: arbitrary detention, torture and executions based on confessions under torture in Hamas-run Gaza; impunity.

HRW May 2019: Hamas arrested >1,000 in March 2019 'We Want to Live' protests (ICHR); Hamas said 4,235 arrested Jan 2018–Mar 2019; ICHR 213 torture complaints vs Hamas, 242 vs PA; Goldstein: 'bitterly divided, but unified in a common approach to crushing dissent'.

12 June 2014 Yifrach, Shaer, Fraenkel abducted; bodies 30 June; Abu Khdeir killed 2 July; Arouri in Turkey called it 'heroic operation' by Qassam, said Hamas 'did not have the intention at this time to ignite a large battle'; 2014 war: >2,000 Palestinians killed, 67 Israelis (all but three soldiers).
State Dept 2018: Iran provides 'up to $100 million annually in combined support' to Palestinian groups including Hamas, PIJ, PFLP-GC, via IRGC-QF with funding, training, weapons.
